name: Grok Bot Skills
description: A curated library of reusable Grok Bot skill recipes.

skills.name: Chief of Staff
skills.description: Your always-on assistant. Scans Slack, email, calendar, and meeting notes and delivers a succinct read-out of what's new and what maps to your priorities — each with a source, why it matters, and what to do.

skills.name: Daily Briefing Writer
skills.description: Start the day with high-quality inputs instead of noise. Delivers a tight daily brief of only the stories that matter to you.

skills.name: Executive Assistant
skills.description: Stay oriented without living in channels. Delivers a morning briefing plus an automatic catch-up summary whenever you join a new room, so you're never lost in a thread you just entered.

skills.name: Inbox Manager
skills.description: Keep email usable. Triages your inbox into clear categories, surfaces urgent and blocked threads, and drafts replies and cleanup — every send stays behind your approval.

skills.name: Presentation Designer
skills.description: Build on-brand decks without starting from a blank slide. Uses your master template and brand system and delivers an editable link ready to refine and present.

skills.name: Status Report Writer
skills.description: Own the to-do so nothing slips. Pulls open action items from docs, meetings, and Slack into one living list and a morning digest.

skills.name: Account Research Specialist
skills.description: Tier accounts before you touch them. Pulls Salesforce + live signals, scores fit and warmth, and builds a shareable research pack per account.

skills.name: CRM Operations Manager
skills.description: Keep the pipeline clean. Handles CRM and org-chart hygiene before and after meetings so records stay current without a manual pass.

skills.name: Deal Desk Coordinator
skills.description: Draft contextual internal deal notes from past emails, Salesforce, and calls, then submit in Salesforce once you approve.
skills.suggested_routine: On deal-stage change or on demand

skills.name: Deck Updater
skills.description: Leave the room with the slide already moving. Updates your deck from discovery notes mid-call or right after, with next steps baked in.

skills.name: Meeting Prep Buddy
skills.description: Walk into every meeting ready. Builds prep packs from calendar, notes, CRM, Gong, and Slack — who's in the room, last touch, open threads, and a suggested agenda.
skills.suggested_routine: Nightly for next-day meetings + 30 min before each

skills.name: Pipeline Analyst
skills.description: Walk into pipe with a clean view. Scrubs Salesforce + sheets, flags stalls and commit risk, and drops a Monday scoreboard.

skills.name: Prospecting Plan Builder
skills.description: Build the week's book of work. Seeds contacts, enriches email/mobile, and writes a ready-to-work tracker so outbound starts from a list.
skills.suggested_routine: Weekly, Sunday evening or Monday 6:00 AM

skills.name: Renewal Desk Operator
skills.description: Walk into every renewal already briefed. Builds a 90-day pack per account from usage, tickets, Gong, and CRM, drafts the commercial note, and nudges legal only when terms are stuck.
skills.suggested_routine: Daily scan; 90 days before each renewal

skills.name: Sales Call Coach
skills.description: Leave every call with homework. Reviews Gong calls and leaves timestamped coaching on discovery, objections, and executive presence, plus a call score.

skills.name: Sales Outbound
skills.description: Hand off research and outbound. Researches accounts overnight, scores contacts with intent, drafts email and LinkedIn in your voice, and leaves a review list for you to approve.

skills.name: Community Operations Manager
skills.description: Keep the ambassador loop moving. Screens apps, triages DMs across channels, and drafts nurture on a cadence so community isn't a full-time chase.

skills.name: Compelling Events Monitor
skills.description: Engage when there's a real reason. Watches leadership posts for awards, launches, and hiring signals, then sends a short digest of posts to engage with — comments or quote reposts in your voice.

skills.name: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
skills.description: See the landscape shift in meaningful ways. Monitors overnight for new launches and audits your site for fatigued creatives and stale messaging. Surfaces only important shifts that gain traction and suggests changes.

skills.name: Event Guest Screener
skills.description: Fill the room with the right people. Scores event applicants against your ICP and batch-approves strong fits in the invite tool.

skills.name: Internal Communications Manager
skills.description: Draft clear, on-voice copy from your real context, matched to each audience and channel. Review-only so it never sends on its own.

skills.name: LinkedIn Campaign Manager
skills.description: Own lead-gen funnel consistency across ads, forms, follow-up, and UTMs. Drafts campaigns for approval and keeps every offer and handoff clean.

skills.name: Marketing Calendar Owner
skills.description: Keep regional and global content, launch, and events calendars in sync. Pulls from Notion and keeps webinars and campaigns current without a weekly chase.

skills.name: Merch Fulfillment Operator
skills.description: Send merch to the right prospects. Runs outreach, watches the redemption form, pings you to approve/reject each submission in chat, and sends your swag vendor a daily order form.

skills.name: Newsletter Writer
skills.description: Ship monthly marketing and product updates on time. Pulls what's new from launches, wins, and your calendar, writes the issue in your voice, and parks it for review so marketing can edit once and send.
skills.suggested_routine: Monthly, a few days before send

skills.name: Paid Media
skills.description: Pulls live channel and campaign data, Slacks a recommended budget reallocation against your monthly plan, and holds for your approval before making adjustments.

skills.name: Paid Media Creative Strategist
skills.description: Spot early creative winners before they're obvious. Writes a sharp why-it-works hypothesis and proposes the next test. No invented metrics.

skills.name: SEO / AEO Auditor
skills.description: Track keyword, technical, AI-prompt, and competitor movement in one place. Surfaces whether you're gaining or losing ground, flags site issues that need a fix, and returns an optimization plan you can act on.

skills.name: Social Media Manager
skills.description: Post in your voice without living in drafts. Studies your real history, drafts when something noteworthy ships, parks posts for you to publish, and keeps the queue moving.

skills.name: Account Health
skills.description: See risk and expansion before the QBR. Reads usage and signals across your book and turns portfolio noise into a clear watch list.

skills.name: Account Manager
skills.description: Keep every key account warm without rebuilding context each time. Preps every call from transcripts, notes, CRM, and Slack, drafts follow-ups, and keeps next steps current.

skills.name: Enablement Fulfillment Specialist
skills.description: Answer "send me the recordings" without digging. Finds Zoom assets, builds one-pagers, uploads to Drive, and drafts the reply with links.

skills.name: Ticket Triage Specialist
skills.description: Clear the queue without living in it. Watches support on a cadence, drafts replies only, and stays quiet when it's clean.

skills.name: Calendar Coordinator
skills.description: Get people in the same room. Schedules across calendars and chases the holds nobody else has time to chase.

skills.name: Hiring Screener
skills.description: Interview the strong ones, not the whole pile. Scores applications or work samples against a defined bar and hands off an ATS-ready review.

skills.name: Onboarding Manager
skills.description: Give new hires a path, not a pile of links. Builds the checklist, pulls the right docs, answers day-one questions, and routes each ask to whoever can unblock it.

skills.name: Talent Scout
skills.description: Keep recruiting moving while you sleep. Runs screen-to-offer: sources candidates, drafts outreach in your voice, skips people already in the ATS, and handles scheduling once you approve.

skills.name: Contract Desk
skills.description: See the week of paper at a glance. Summarizes contracts by stage and owner, pulls key terms, and flags blocked reviews.

skills.name: Expense Manager
skills.description: Stay on top of the money. Builds the weekly summary from your expense manager and sheets, logs new receipts from email, and nudges owners on missing categories before review.

skills.name: Invoice Coordinator
skills.description: Stop invoices from sitting. Forwards invoices, matches what it can, tracks vendor actuals, and nudges the right owner when something needs a human.

skills.name: Security Questionnaire Filler
skills.description: Speed through vendor security portals. Logs into the questionnaire site, pulls answers from your trust center and past RFPs, drafts every field, and parks the submit for you.

skills.name: Vendor Portal Operator
skills.description: Run renewals, seats, and procurement on portals with no clean API. Clicks the same path every week and comes back with exceptions only.

skills.name: Beta Adoption Watcher
skills.description: See who's actually trying the new feature. Monitors usage and surfaces which customers are in, so the team can follow up.

skills.name: Call FAQ Miner
skills.description: Keep enablement current from real calls. Tracks recurring questions, timestamps answers, and links back to the source recording.

skills.name: Docs Auditor
skills.description: Catch docs that are out of date with the product. Diffs help center and internal notes against what shipped last week, flags stale pages, and drafts the rewrite.

skills.name: Feature Request Tracker
skills.description: Never lose "who asked for this." Mines Slack and calls into a living list tied to customers, so the spec has a real demand trail.

skills.name: Product Feedback Analyst
skills.description: Turn scattered product signal into a prioritized view. Collects and clusters feedback from connected sources, weighs evidence and urgency, and drafts routing recommendations for approval.

skills.name: Bug Reproduction
skills.description: Give engineers reports they can trust. Catches the thread, clicks the same path in staging, captures the failure, and drops a repro pack — steps, screenshots, network notes.

skills.name: Cloud Agent Orchestrator
skills.description: Keep many cloud agent runs moving without babysitting each one. Kicks off runs, monitors, chases what's stuck, and summarizes the report.

skills.name: Playtest Operator
skills.description: Brute-force test the product path when APIs aren't enough. Drives the UI on a computer, captures failures, and returns a tight findings pack.

skills.name: Product Performance
skills.description: Get a clear view of the metrics that matter. Logs into observability tools, walks the flamegraphs, and comes back with hotspots plus a short writeup with screenshots.

skills.name: Prototype Builder
skills.description: Go from ask to something clickable fast. Writes code on its computer and comes back with a screenshot plus a live URL.

skills.name: Apartment Scout
skills.description: Book tours with a shortlist of eligible apartments as soon as they hit the market. Filters listings, emails to book tour times, and applies for the ones you pick.

skills.name: Personal Site Builder
skills.description: Scaffold a personal site from a description, untangle domain issues, and leave you with a live starting point.

skills.name: Subscription Cleaner
skills.description: Cut the noise you forgot about. Collates receipt and newsletter mail, suggests what to kill, and unsubscribes what you approve.

skills.name: Travel Coordinator
skills.description: Hold the best option before it expires. Compares flights and hotels to your rules, confirms before booking, and drops itinerary plus calendar.

skills.name: Brand Voice Keeper
skills.description: Learn your brand voice once, then rewrite or check any copy against it. Use to keep tone consistent across writers and channels, or to fix off-voice drafts.

skills.name: Content Repurposer
skills.description: Turn one asset (post, blog, talk, webinar) into a pack of channel-native derivatives — thread, LinkedIn post, newsletter blurb, video script, quote cards. Use to get full mileage from one piece.

skills.name: Hook & Headline Tester
skills.description: Generate and rank hooks, headlines, and subject lines against your goal and audience — with a clear rationale for the top picks. Use before you ship copy, not after it underperforms.

skills.name: Image Concept Generator
skills.description: Go from a brief to on-brand image concepts and generation-ready prompts. Use when you need visuals for a post, blog, ad, or deck and want options, not one guess.

skills.name: Meme Maker
skills.description: Draft topical, on-brand memes that fit the moment without being cringe. Use when you want reactive social content that lands, cleared before it posts.

skills.name: Naming & Tagline Brainstormer
skills.description: Generate and pressure-test names and taglines for products, features, or campaigns — with domain/handle and trademark sanity checks. Use when you need options with a shortlist, not 200 raw ideas.

skills.name: Short Video Script Writer
skills.description: Write scroll-stopping short-form video scripts (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) with a hook, beats, on-screen text, and a CTA. Use when you need a shoot-ready script, not a vague idea.

skills.name: Thread Writer
skills.description: Turn a topic, doc, or launch into a well-structured X thread in your voice — strong hook, one idea per post, clean payoff. Use when you want a thread drafted, not a wall of text.

skills.name: Call & Video Summarizer
skills.description: Turn a recording, transcript, or long video into a tight summary with decisions, action items, and timestamped highlights. Use to capture what happened without rewatching.

skills.name: Deep Research Brief
skills.description: Answer a hard question with a sourced, structured brief — not a wall of links. Use for market/company/topic research where you need a decision-ready synthesis with citations.

skills.name: Fact Checker
skills.description: Verify claims before you publish or act. Use to check a post, draft, stat, or forwarded claim against primary sources and get a verdict with evidence.

skills.name: Trend Radar
skills.description: Catch what's breaking in your space on X and the web before it's obvious. Use for a real-time digest of emerging trends, narratives, and conversations relevant to you — signal, with sources.

skills.name: Anomaly Watcher
skills.description: Catch metric anomalies before they become fire drills. Use to monitor key metrics on a cadence and alert — with likely causes — only when something is genuinely off.

skills.name: Cohort & Funnel Analyzer
skills.description: Find where users drop off and which cohorts retain. Use to build retention curves and funnel breakdowns from event data and get a plain-language read on where to focus.

skills.name: Dashboard Builder
skills.description: Go from a question to a working dashboard. Use to design and build (or refresh) a dashboard from your data sources, with the right charts for each metric and sane defaults.

skills.name: Metrics Report Builder
skills.description: Turn raw data into a recurring metrics report that explains movement, not just numbers. Use for a weekly/monthly KPI digest with drivers, anomalies, and plain-language takeaways.

skills.name: SQL Query Assistant
skills.description: Answer a data question in plain English with a correct, explained SQL query. Use to draft, run (read-only), and sanity-check queries against your warehouse — not to guess numbers.

skills.name: Spreadsheet Cleaner
skills.description: Turn a messy spreadsheet into clean, analysis-ready data. Use to fix malformed rows, inconsistent formats, duplicates, and stray headers — with a log of every change.
